english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an adhesive label or decal.
Use this when the English item is a decorative adhesive sticker rather than an inking stamp.

examples.english: I put a sticker on my water bottle.
examples.traditional: 我喺水樽上面貼咗張貼紙。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 seoi2 zeon1 soeng6 min6 tip3 zo2 zoeng1 tip3 zi2

examples.english: I bought some stamp-themed stickers to decorate the card.
examples.traditional: 我買咗啲貼紙裝飾張卡。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 tip3 zi2 zong1 sik1 zoeng1 kaa1
